1.web: Woe to those who are at ease in Zion, and to those who are secure on the mountain of Samaria, the notable men of the chief of the nations, to whom the house of Israel come!
1.asv: Woe to them that are at ease in Zion, and to them that are secure in the mountain of Samaria, the notable men of the chief of the nations, to whom the house of Israel come!

2.web: Go to Calneh, and see; and from there go to Hamath the great; then go down to Gath of the Philistines. are they better than these kingdoms? or is their border greater than your border?
2.asv: Pass ye unto Calneh, and see; and from thence go ye to Hamath the great; then go down to Gath of the Philistines: are they better than these kingdoms? or is their border greater than your border?

3.web: Those who put far away the evil day, and cause the seat of violence to come near;
3.asv: —ye that put far away the evil day, and cause the seat of violence to come near;

4.web: Who lie on beds of ivory, and stretch themselves on their couches, and eat the lambs out of the flock, and the calves out of the midst of the stall;
4.asv: that lie upon beds of ivory, and stretch themselves upon their couches, and eat the lambs out of the flock, and the calves out of the midst of the stall;

5.web: who strum on the strings of a harp; who invent for themselves instruments of music, like David;
5.asv: that sing idle songs to the sound of the viol; that invent for themselves instruments of music, like David;

6.web: who drink wine in bowls, and anoint themselves with the best oils; but they are not grieved for the affliction of Joseph.
6.asv: that drink wine in bowls, and anoint themselves with the chief oils; but they are not grieved for the affliction of Joseph.

7.web: Therefore they will now go captive with the first who go captive; and the feasting and lounging will end.
7.asv: Therefore shall they now go captive with the first that go captive; and the revelry of them that stretched themselves shall pass away.

8.web: “The Lord Yahweh has sworn by himself,” says Yahweh, the God of Armies: “I abhor the pride of Jacob, and detest his fortresses. Therefore I will deliver up the city with all that is in it.
8.asv: The Lord Jehovah hath sworn by himself, saith Jehovah, the God of hosts: I abhor the excellency of Jacob, and hate his palaces; therefore will I deliver up the city with all that is therein.

9.web: It will happen, if there remain ten men in one house, that they shall die.
9.asv: And it shall come to pass, if there remain ten men in one house, that they shall die.

10.web: “When a man’s relative carries him, even he who burns him, to bring bodies out of the house, and asks him who is in the innermost parts of the house, ‘Is there yet any with you?’ And he says, ‘No;’ then he will say, ‘Hush! Indeed we must not mention Yahweh’s name.’
10.asv: And when a man’s uncle shall take him up, even he that burneth him, to bring out the bones out of the house, and shall say unto him that is in the innermost parts of the house, Is there yet any with thee? and he shall say, No; then shall he say, Hold thy peace; for we may not make mention of the name of Jehovah.

11.web: “For, behold, Yahweh commands, and the great house will be smashed to pieces, and the little house into bits.
11.asv: For, behold, Jehovah commandeth, and the great house shall be smitten with breaches, and the little house with clefts.

12.web: Do horses run on the rocky crags? Does one plow there with oxen? But you have turned justice into poison, and the fruit of righteousness into bitterness;
12.asv: Shall horses run upon the rock? will one plowtherewith oxen? that ye have turned justice into gall, and the fruit of righteousness into wormwood;

13.web: you who rejoice in a thing of nothing, who say, ‘Haven’t we taken for ourselves horns by our own strength?’
13.asv: ye that rejoice in a thing of nought, that say, Have we not taken to us horns by our own strength?

14.web: For, behold, I will raise up against you a nation, house of Israel,” says Yahweh, the God of Armies; “and they will afflict you from the entrance of Hamath to the brook of the Arabah.”
14.asv: For, behold, I will raise up against you a nation, O house of Israel, saith Jehovah, the God of hosts; and they shall afflict you from the entrance of Hamath unto the brook of the Arabah.
